DE.source: SOG DE wrapper (app/internal/modules/algoritmo/otimizacao/de.py, utils.py) with the CA_*_DE seed-validation notebook controls; notebook repo 9194f635

PSO.source: SOG PSO wrapper (app/internal/modules/algoritmo/otimizacao/pso.py) with the CA_*_PSO seed-validation notebook controls; notebook repo 9194f635

UPSO.source: SOG CA_*_UPSO seed-validation notebooks: the same PSO wrapper as PSO with c1=0.6 and c2=0.4; notebook repo 9194f635

notes: Native SOG controls and stopping rules; no shared evaluation budget. DE may use up to 960 x 101 = 96960 evaluations (scipy tol=0.09 can stop it earlier); PSO and UPSO up to 200 x 251 = 50200 (pyswarm minstep/minfunc 1e-8 can stop them earlier).
Each run seeds the global NumPy RNG once, as SOG does with np.random.seed before calling SciPy and pyswarm.
DE runs with one worker: SOG requested workers=-1, which cannot share the evaluation counter across processes. Evolutionary controls are unchanged.
Use this profile to describe how the SOG configurations behave; use budget_matched.json for the statistical comparison.
